notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
What's new:

• New look on some of the demo levels.
• Camera now rotates by holding right click instead of left click.
• Added new speeds to the camera rotation settings (was too high).
• Added more visual clues where players might get stuck.
• Better animation while holding the crystals.
• Fixed player bug while getting killed by spikes and other obstacles.
• Fixed some other minor bugs.

Most of these issues were mentioned on a Youtube gameplay video made by "[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LNLj0TsWGjc]Trunk The Shiny[/url]" while playing the demo.
